comments.text:
I deployed a Vite React project on Vercel, and it works fine. However, when I tried to set up an API using NestJS to serve the front end, I encountered a problem. The NestJS server is trying to load the assets, including the index.js file, but it returns a 404 error because it can't find the file. As a result, nothing is displayed.

The assets I’m trying to load are included in the code files I deployed to Vercel, and I'm calling this deployed code from Vercel to use as the interface for the API I’m developing. The only solution I see is to build the project again and include it in the NestJS file structure.

Can you please advise me on how to resolve this issue?
